system.longDesc:
Area of Effect 5 M/15m

Amateur makeshift grenades sometimes appear as a part of emergency defense. They have the Unreliable flaw and usually inflict less damage than standard grenades. The GM can change the damage or area of effect of a homemade grenade depending on the quality and materials used.

Thrown: short range 4 m, long range 8 m (Accuracy (Throwing) test, TN 11).
